_comment: Copy to app.local.json (gitignored) and edit for this machine. Only override what needs to differ from app.json -- Config::mergeFromFile does a JSON merge_patch on top of the base config, not a full replace.
_comment_control_source: "auto" (the app.json default) probes at startup: Pisound if present, else any connected USB MIDI/audio device, else the mock. Force one with "pisound" / "midi" / "mock" if you need to.

midi._comment: port_name is a SUBSTRING match; empty lets auto-select prefer a USB controller. knobA/B map assignable CC knobs.

audio._comment: device_name is a substring override; empty lets auto-select prefer a USB capture device, then the system default.
